title: Quiet Morning
description: A gentle original picking study: right-hand pattern, thumb, then easy C, G and D shapes.

lessons.title: Quiet Morning - The Picking Pattern
lessons.description: Learn i-m-a-m-i on open G, B and high E.

lessons.title: Quiet Morning - Add the Thumb
lessons.description: Add open low E together with the first G-string note.

lessons.title: Quiet Morning - Your First C Shape
lessons.description: Hold a two-finger partial C while the right hand repeats.

lessons.title: Quiet Morning - Your First G Shape
lessons.description: Prepare a two-finger partial G without changing the picking pattern.

lessons.title: Quiet Morning - Move from C to G
lessons.description: Play C twice, then G twice, keeping the right hand steady.

lessons.title: Quiet Morning - Your First D Shape
lessons.description: Learn open D using only frets 2 and 3.

lessons.title: Quiet Morning - Move from G to D
lessons.description: Keep each shape for two bars before changing.

lessons.title: Quiet Morning - Quiet Morning
lessons.description: Join C, G and D into a gentle repeating guitar piece.
